=γn,m,λ​(ρ⋆)​𝔼𝒟​‖u‖X2+c​(𝔼𝒟​‖v‖Z2−b​ρ⋆c​𝔼𝒟​‖u‖X2)2\displaystyle=\gamma_{n,m,\lambda}(\rho_{\star})\mathbb{E}_{\mathscr{D}}\left\lVert u\right\rVert^{2}_{X}+c\left(\sqrt{\mathbb{E}_{\mathscr{D}}\left\lVert v\right\rVert^{2}_{Z}}-\frac{b\rho_{\star}}{c}\sqrt{\mathbb{E}_{\mathscr{D}}\left\lVert u\right\rVert^{2}_{X}}\right)^{2}
≥γn,m,λ​(ρ⋆)​𝔼𝒟​‖u‖X2.\displaystyle\geq\gamma_{n,m,\lambda}(\rho_{\star})\mathbb{E}_{\mathscr{D}}\left\lVert u\right\rVert^{2}_{X}.

Throughout, we use uppercase letters (e.g., Xi,Zi,YiX_{i},Z_{i},Y_{i}) for random variables and lowercase letters (e.g., xi,zi,yix_{i},z_{i},y_{i}) for their realizations. We write xn=(x1,…,xn)x^{n}=(x_{1},\ldots,x_{n}) and zn=(z1,…,zn)z^{n}=(z_{1},\ldots,z_{n}) for the labeled sample locations, and xm=(xn+1,…,xN)x^{m}=(x_{n+1},\ldots,x_{N}) and zm=(zn+1,…,zN)z^{m}=(z_{n+1},\ldots,z_{N}) for the unlabeled ones (where m=N−nm=N-n). We also use xN=(x1,…,xN)x^{N}=(x_{1},\ldots,x_{N}) and zN=(z1,…,zN)z^{N}=(z_{1},\ldots,z_{N}) to denote the full collection of sample points. Define

ki​(f,g)\displaystyle k_{i}(f,g) ≔(f⁡(xi)−yi)2+λ​(g⁡(zi)−yi)2−[(f⋆​(xi)−yi)2+λ​(g⋆​(zi)−yi)2],\displaystyle\coloneq(f(x_{i})-y_{i})^{2}+\lambda(g(z_{i})-y_{i})^{2}-\bigl[(f^{\star}(x_{i})-y_{i})^{2}+\lambda(g^{\star}(z_{i})-y_{i})^{2}\bigr],
pj​(f,g)\displaystyle p_{j}(f,g) ≔(f⁡(xj)−g⁡(zj))2−(f⋆​(xj)−g⋆​(zj))2.\displaystyle\coloneq(f(x_{j})-g(z_{j}))^{2}-(f^{\star}(x_{j})-g^{\star}(z_{j}))^{2}.

For notational convenience, throughout the remainder of the text we write ∑i\sum_{i} for ∑i=1n\sum_{i=1}^{n} and ∑j\sum_{j} for ∑j=n+1N\sum_{j=n+1}^{N}. We now state a result adapted from Györfi et al. (2002, Theorem 11.4).

Theorem C.2.

Assume that 2.5 holds.

Then

ℙ{∃(f,g)∈ℱ×𝒢:𝔼[ℒ^(f,g;λ)]−𝔼[ℒ^(f⋆,g⋆;λ)]−1N(∑iki+∑jpj)\displaystyle\mathbb{P}\Bigg\{\exists(f,g)\in\mathcal{F}\times\mathcal{G}:\mathbb{E}[\hat{\mathcal{L}}(f,g;\lambda)]-\mathbb{E}[\hat{\mathcal{L}}(f^{\star},g^{\star};\lambda)]-\frac{1}{N}\left(\sum\limits_{i}k_{i}+\sum\limits_{j}p_{j}\right)
≥ϵ(α+β+𝔼[ℒ^(f,g;λ)]−𝔼[ℒ^(f⋆,g⋆;λ)])}\displaystyle\qquad\qquad\geq\epsilon\left(\alpha+\beta+\mathbb{E}[\hat{\mathcal{L}}(f,g;\lambda)]-\mathbb{E}[\hat{\mathcal{L}}(f^{\star},g^{\star};\lambda)]\right)\Bigg\}
≤10​𝔐ℱ,𝒢n,m,λ​exp⁡(−ϵ2​(1−ϵ)​α​N512​B2​(λ+1)),\displaystyle\leq 10\mathfrak{M}_{\mathcal{F},\mathcal{G}}^{n,m,\lambda}\exp\left(-\dfrac{\epsilon^{2}(1-\epsilon)\alpha N}{512B^{2}(\lambda+1)}\right),

where α,β>0,\alpha,\beta>0, 0<ϵ<1,0<\epsilon<1, and

𝔐ℱ,𝒢n,m,λ≔\displaystyle\mathfrak{M}_{\mathcal{F},\mathcal{G}}^{n,m,\lambda}\coloneqq maxzn⁡𝒩1​((α+β)80​B2​λ+1​a,ℱ,xn)⋅𝒩1​((α+β)80​B2​a​(λ+1)3/2,𝒢,zn)+\displaystyle\max_{z^{n}}\mathcal{N}_{1}\left(\dfrac{(\alpha+\beta)}{80B^{2}\sqrt{\lambda+1}a},\mathcal{F},x^{n}\right)\cdot\mathcal{N}_{1}\left(\dfrac{(\alpha+\beta)}{80B^{2}a(\lambda+1)^{3/2}},\mathcal{G},z^{n}\right)+
maxzm⁡𝒩1​((α+β)80​B2​λ+1​b,ℱ,xm)⋅𝒩1​((α+β)80​B2​λ+1​b,𝒢,zm)+\displaystyle\max_{z^{m}}\mathcal{N}_{1}\left(\dfrac{(\alpha+\beta)}{80B^{2}\sqrt{\lambda+1}b},\mathcal{F},x^{m}\right)\cdot\mathcal{N}_{1}\left(\dfrac{(\alpha+\beta)}{80B^{2}\sqrt{\lambda+1}b},\mathcal{G},z^{m}\right)+
maxzN⁡𝒩1​(ϵ​β40​B​λ+1,ℱ,xN)⋅𝒩1​(ϵ​β40​(λ+1)3/2​B,𝒢,zN).\displaystyle\max_{z^{N}}\mathcal{N}_{1}\left(\dfrac{\epsilon\beta}{40B\sqrt{\lambda+1}},\mathcal{F},x^{N}\right)\cdot\mathcal{N}_{1}\left(\dfrac{\epsilon\beta}{40(\lambda+1)^{3/2}B},\mathcal{G},z^{N}\right).
Proof.

Throughout this proof, for (f,g)∈ℱ×𝒢(f,g)\in\mathcal{F}\times\mathcal{G}, we interpret ff and gg pointwise, writing f≡f⁡(X)f\equiv f(X), g≡g⁡(Z)g\equiv g(Z), so that expressions such as (f−Y)2(f-Y)^{2}, (g−Y)2(g-Y)^{2}, and (f−g)2(f-g)^{2} are understood as (f⁡(X)−Y)2(f(X)-Y)^{2}, (g⁡(Z)−Y)2(g(Z)-Y)^{2}, and (f⁡(X)−g⁡(Z))2(f(X)-g(Z))^{2}, respectively.

For a sample (X,Z,Y)(X,Z,Y), define the ∗*-norm

‖(f,g)−(Y,Y)‖∗2≔a​(f−Y)2+a​λ​(g−Y)2+b​(f−g)2.\|(f,g)-(Y,Y)\|_{*}^{2}\coloneq a(f-Y)^{2}+a\lambda(g-Y)^{2}+b(f-g)^{2}.

Denote

Af,g≔‖(f,g)−(Y,Y)‖∗2−‖(f⋆,g⋆)−(Y,Y)‖∗2=a​k​(f,g)+b​p​(f,g),A_{f,g}\coloneq\|(f,g)-(Y,Y)\|_{*}^{2}-\|(f^{\star},g^{\star})-(Y,Y)\|_{*}^{2}=a\,k(f,g)+b\,p(f,g),

where k⁡(f,g)=(f−Y)2+λ​(g−Y)2−[(f⋆−Y)2+λ​(g⋆−Y)2]k(f,g)=(f-Y)^{2}+\lambda(g-Y)^{2}-\bigl[(f^{\star}-Y)^{2}+\lambda(g^{\star}-Y)^{2}\bigr], and p⁡(f,g)=(f−g)2−(f⋆−g⋆)2.p(f,g)=(f-g)^{2}-(f^{\star}-g^{\star})^{2}.

By the definition above, our goal is to bound

ℙ⁡{∃(f,g)∈ℱ×𝒢:𝔼⁡[Af,g]−1N​∑iki−1N​∑jpj≥ϵ⁡(α+β+𝔼⁡[Af,g])}\mathbb{P}\left\{\exists(f,g)\in\mathcal{F}\times\mathcal{G}:\mathbb{E}[A_{f,g}]-\frac{1}{N}\sum_{i}k_{i}-\frac{1}{N}\sum_{j}p_{j}\geq\epsilon\left(\alpha+\beta+\mathbb{E}[A_{f,g}]\right)\right\} (12)

Observe that when N≤128​(λ+1)​B2ϵ2​(α+β)N\leq\dfrac{128(\lambda+1)B^{2}}{\epsilon^{2}\left(\alpha+\beta\right)}, we have

10​𝔐ℱ,𝒢n,m,λ​exp⁡(−ϵ2​(1−ϵ)​α​N512​B2​(λ+1))≥15​exp⁡(−ϵ2​(1−ϵ)​(α+β)​N512​B2​(λ+1))≥15​exp⁡(−128512)>1,10\mathfrak{M}_{\mathcal{F},\mathcal{G}}^{n,m,\lambda}\exp\left(-\dfrac{\epsilon^{2}(1-\epsilon)\alpha N}{512B^{2}(\lambda+1)}\right)\geq 15\exp\left(-\dfrac{\epsilon^{2}(1-\epsilon)(\alpha+\beta)N}{512B^{2}(\lambda+1)}\right)\geq 15\exp\left(-\dfrac{128}{512}\right)>1,

thus it is sufficient to only consider the case when N>128​(λ+1)​B2ϵ2​(α+β)N>\dfrac{128(\lambda+1)B^{2}}{\epsilon^{2}\left(\alpha+\beta\right)}.

To bound (12), we divide the proof into several steps.

Step 1. Symmetrization
Let 𝒟L′={(Xi′,Wi′,Yi′)}i=1n∼i.i.d.PX,W,Y\mathscr{D}^{\prime}_{L}=\{(X^{\prime}_{i},W^{\prime}_{i},Y^{\prime}_{i})\}_{i=1}^{n}\stackrel{{\scriptstyle\text{i.i.d.}}}{{\sim}}P_{X,W,Y}, and 𝒟U′={Zj′=(Xj′,Wj′)}j=n+1N∼i.i.d.PX,W,\mathscr{D}^{\prime}_{U}=\{Z^{\prime}_{j}=(X^{\prime}_{j},W^{\prime}_{j})\}_{j=n+1}^{N}\stackrel{{\scriptstyle\text{i.i.d.}}}{{\sim}}P_{X,W}, be a ghost sample independent of 𝒟L\mathscr{D}_{L} and 𝒟U\mathscr{D}_{U}, respectively. Denote

ki′\displaystyle k^{\prime}_{i} =(f⁡(Xi′)−Yi′)2+λ​(g⁡(Zi′)−Yi′)2−(f⋆​(Xi′)−Yi′)2−λ​(g⋆​(Zi′)−Yi′)2,\displaystyle=(f(X^{\prime}_{i})-Y^{\prime}_{i})^{2}+\lambda\,(g(Z^{\prime}_{i})-Y^{\prime}_{i})^{2}-(f^{\star}(X^{\prime}_{i})-Y^{\prime}_{i})^{2}-\lambda\,(g^{\star}(Z^{\prime}_{i})-Y^{\prime}_{i})^{2},
pj′\displaystyle p^{\prime}_{j} =(f⁡(Xj′)−g⁡(Zj′))2−(f⋆​(Xj′)−g⋆​(Zj′))2,\displaystyle=(f(X^{\prime}_{j})-g(Z^{\prime}_{j}))^{2}-(f^{\star}(X^{\prime}_{j})-g^{\star}(Z^{\prime}_{j}))^{2},

and define the original and ghost collections of labeled and unlabeled summands

𝒟={ki,pj:1≤i≤n,n+1≤j≤N},𝒟′={ki′,pj′:1≤i≤n,n+1≤j≤N}.\mathscr{D}=\{\,k_{i},\,p_{j}:1\leq i\leq n,\;n+1\leq j\leq N\,\},\qquad\mathscr{D}^{\prime}=\{\,k^{\prime}_{i},\,p^{\prime}_{j}:1\leq i\leq n,\;n+1\leq j\leq N\,\}.

We will show that

ℙ⁡{∃(f,g)∈ℱ×𝒢:𝔼⁡[Af,g]−1N​∑iki−1N​∑jpj≥ϵ⁡(α+β+𝔼⁡[Af,g])}\displaystyle\mathbb{P}\Bigl\{\exists(f,g)\in\mathcal{F}\times\mathcal{G}\colon\mathbb{E}[A_{f,g}]-\dfrac{1}{N}\sum_{i}k_{i}-\dfrac{1}{N}\sum_{j}p_{j}\geq\epsilon\bigl(\alpha+\beta+\mathbb{E}[A_{f,g}]\bigr)\Bigr\}
≤87​ℙ​{∃(f,g)∈ℱ×𝒢:1N​(∑i(ki′−ki)+∑j(pj′−pj))≥ϵ2​(α+β+𝔼⁡[Af,g])}\displaystyle\leq\tfrac{8}{7}\;\mathbb{P}\Bigl\{\exists(f,g)\in\mathcal{F}\times\mathcal{G}\colon\dfrac{1}{N}\Bigl(\sum_{i}\bigl(k_{i}^{\prime}-k_{i}\bigr)+\sum_{j}\bigl(p_{j}^{\prime}-p_{j}\bigr)\Bigr)\geq\tfrac{\epsilon}{2}\bigl(\alpha+\beta+\mathbb{E}[A_{f,g}]\bigr)\Bigr\} (13)

To prove this, consider

Var⁡(1N​(∑iki′+∑jpj′))=1N2​Var​(∑iki′+∑jpj′)≤1N2​(n​Var​(k1′)+m​Var​(p1′))\displaystyle\mathrm{Var}\left(\frac{1}{N}\Bigl(\sum_{i}k_{i}^{\prime}+\sum_{j}p_{j}^{\prime}\Bigr)\right)=\frac{1}{N^{2}}\mathrm{Var}\left(\sum_{i}k_{i}^{\prime}+\sum_{j}p_{j}^{\prime}\right)\leq\frac{1}{N^{2}}\Bigl(n\mathrm{Var}(k_{1}^{\prime})+m\mathrm{Var}(p_{1}^{\prime})\Bigr)
≤aN​𝔼​[((f−y)2+λ​(g−y)2−(f⋆−y)2−λ​(g⋆−y)2)2]+bN​𝔼​[((f−g)2−(f⋆−g⋆)2)2]\displaystyle\leq\frac{a}{N}\mathbb{E}\left[\Bigl((f-y)^{2}+\lambda(g-y)^{2}-(f^{\star}-y)^{2}-\lambda(g^{\star}-y)^{2}\Bigr)^{2}\right]+\frac{b}{N}\mathbb{E}\left[\Bigl((f-g)^{2}-(f^{\star}-g^{\star})^{2}\Bigr)^{2}\right]
≤1N𝔼[a((f+f⋆−2y)(f−f⋆)+λ(g+g⋆−2y)(g−g⋆))2\displaystyle\leq\frac{1}{N}\mathbb{E}\Bigl[a\bigl((f+f^{\star}-2y)(f-f^{\star})+\lambda(g+g^{\star}-2y)(g-g^{\star})\bigr)^{2}
+b((f−g+f⋆−g⋆)(f−g−f⋆+g⋆))2]\displaystyle\qquad+b\bigl((f-g+f^{\star}-g^{\star})(f-g-f^{\star}+g^{\star})\bigr)^{2}\Bigr]
≤(∗)1N𝔼[a((f+f⋆−2y)2+λ(g+g⋆−2y)2)((f−f⋆)2+λ(g−g⋆)2)\displaystyle\stackrel{{\scriptstyle(*)}}{{\leq}}\frac{1}{N}\mathbb{E}\Bigl[a\bigl((f+f^{\star}-2y)^{2}+\lambda(g+g^{\star}-2y)^{2}\bigr)\bigl((f-f^{\star})^{2}+\lambda(g-g^{\star})^{2}\bigr)
+b((f−g+f⋆−g⋆)(f−g−f⋆+g⋆))2]\displaystyle\qquad+b\bigl((f-g+f^{\star}-g^{\star})(f-g-f^{\star}+g^{\star})\bigr)^{2}\Bigr]
≤16​(λ+1)​B2N​𝔼​[(a⁡((f−f⋆)2+λ​(g−g⋆)2)+b​(f−f⋆+g⋆−g)2)]\displaystyle\leq\frac{16(\lambda+1)B^{2}}{N}\mathbb{E}\Bigl[\bigl(a\bigl((f-f^{\star})^{2}+\lambda(g-g^{\star})^{2}\bigr)+b\bigl(f-f^{\star}+g^{\star}-g\bigr)^{2}\bigr)\Bigr]
=16​(λ+1)​B2N​𝔼​[‖(f,g)−(f⋆,g⋆)‖∗2]\displaystyle=\frac{16(\lambda+1)B^{2}}{N}\mathbb{E}\left[\bigl\|(f,g)-(f^{\star},g^{\star})\bigr\|_{*}^{2}\right]
≤(†)16​(λ+1)​B2N​𝔼​[‖(f,g)−(Y,Y)‖∗2−‖(f⋆,g⋆)−(Y,Y)‖∗2]\displaystyle\stackrel{{\scriptstyle({\dagger})}}{{\leq}}\frac{16(\lambda+1)B^{2}}{N}\mathbb{E}\left[\|(f,g)-(Y,Y)\|_{*}^{2}-\|(f^{\star},g^{\star})-(Y,Y)\|_{*}^{2}\right]

where (∗)(*) follows by applying Cauchy–Schwarz, and (†)({\dagger}) holds since (f⋆,g⋆)(f^{\star},g^{\star}) minimizes 𝔼​‖(f,g)−(Y,Y)‖∗2=ℒ⁡(f,g,λ)\mathbb{E}\|(f,g)-(Y,Y)\|_{*}^{2}=\mathcal{L}(f,g;\lambda). Thus,

𝔼⁡[Af,g]≥116​(λ+1)​B2​(a​𝔼​[k2​(f,g)]+b​𝔼​[p2​(f,g)])\mathbb{E}\left[A_{f,g}\right]\geq\frac{1}{16(\lambda+1)B^{2}}\left(a\mathbb{E}[k^{2}(f,g)]+b\mathbb{E}[p^{2}(f,g)]\right) (15)

𝔼⁡[Af𝒟,g𝒟∣𝒟]−1N​∑iki​(f𝒟,g𝒟)−1N​∑jpj​(f𝒟,g𝒟)≥ϵ⁡(α+β+𝔼⁡[Af𝒟,g𝒟∣𝒟]).\mathbb{E}\Bigl[A_{f_{\mathscr{D}},g_{\mathscr{D}}}\mid\mathscr{D}\Bigr]-\frac{1}{N}\sum_{i}k_{i}(f_{\mathscr{D}},g_{\mathscr{D}})-\frac{1}{N}\sum_{j}p_{j}(f_{\mathscr{D}},g_{\mathscr{D}})\geq\epsilon\left(\alpha+\beta+\mathbb{E}\Bigl[A_{f_{\mathscr{D}},g_{\mathscr{D}}}\mid\mathscr{D}\Bigr]\right).

And consider

ℙ{𝔼[Af𝒟,g𝒟∣𝒟]−1N∑iki′(f𝒟,g𝒟)−1N∑jpj′(f𝒟,g𝒟)≥ϵ2(α+β+𝔼[Af𝒟,g𝒟∣𝒟])}\displaystyle\mathbb{P}\left\{\mathbb{E}\Bigl[A_{f_{\mathscr{D}},g_{\mathscr{D}}}\mid\mathscr{D}\Bigr]-\frac{1}{N}\sum_{i}k_{i}^{\prime}(f_{\mathscr{D}},g_{\mathscr{D}})-\frac{1}{N}\sum_{j}p_{j}^{\prime}(f_{\mathscr{D}},g_{\mathscr{D}})\geq\dfrac{\epsilon}{2}\left(\alpha+\beta+\mathbb{E}\Bigl[A_{f_{\mathscr{D}},g_{\mathscr{D}}}\mid\mathscr{D}\Bigr]\right)\right\}

where (∗)(*) follows by (14) and in the last inequality we used N>128​(λ+1)​B2ϵ2​(α+β)N>\dfrac{128(\lambda+1)B^{2}}{\epsilon^{2}\left(\alpha+\beta\right)}.

Define the two events

𝒜\displaystyle\mathcal{A} ≔{𝔼[Af𝒟,g𝒟∣𝒟]−1N∑iki(f𝒟,g𝒟)−1N∑jpj(f𝒟,g𝒟)≥ϵ(α+β+𝔼[Af𝒟,g𝒟∣𝒟])}\displaystyle\coloneq\left\{\mathbb{E}\Bigl[A_{f_{\mathscr{D}},g_{\mathscr{D}}}\mid\mathscr{D}\Bigr]-\frac{1}{N}\sum_{i}k_{i}(f_{\mathscr{D}},g_{\mathscr{D}})-\frac{1}{N}\sum_{j}p_{j}(f_{\mathscr{D}},g_{\mathscr{D}})\geq\epsilon\left(\alpha+\beta+\mathbb{E}\Bigl[A_{f_{\mathscr{D}},g_{\mathscr{D}}}\mid\mathscr{D}\Bigr]\right)\right\}

Hence,

ℙ⁡{∃(f,g)∈ℱ×𝒢:𝔼⁡[Af,g]−1N​∑iki−1N​∑jpj≥ϵ⁡(α+β+𝔼⁡[Af,g])}\displaystyle\mathbb{P}\left\{\exists(f,g)\in\mathcal{F}\times\mathcal{G}:\mathbb{E}[A_{f,g}]-\frac{1}{N}\sum_{i}k_{i}-\frac{1}{N}\sum_{j}p_{j}\geq\epsilon\left(\alpha+\beta+\mathbb{E}[A_{f,g}]\right)\right\}
=ℙ{𝔼[Af𝒟,g𝒟∣𝒟]−1N∑iki(f𝒟,g𝒟)−1N∑jpj(f𝒟,g𝒟)≥ϵ(α+β+𝔼[Af𝒟,g𝒟∣𝒟])}\displaystyle=\mathbb{P}\left\{\mathbb{E}\Bigl[A_{f_{\mathscr{D}},g_{\mathscr{D}}}\mid\mathscr{D}\Bigr]-\frac{1}{N}\sum_{i}k_{i}(f_{\mathscr{D}},g_{\mathscr{D}})-\frac{1}{N}\sum_{j}p_{j}(f_{\mathscr{D}},g_{\mathscr{D}})\geq\epsilon\left(\alpha+\beta+\mathbb{E}\Bigl[A_{f_{\mathscr{D}},g_{\mathscr{D}}}\mid\mathscr{D}\Bigr]\right)\right\}
=ℙ⁡{𝒜∩ℬ}/ℙ⁡{ℬ∣𝒜}≤87​ℙ​{𝒜∩ℬ}\displaystyle=\mathbb{P}\{\mathcal{A}\cap\mathcal{B}\}/\mathbb{P}\left\{\mathcal{B}\mid\mathcal{A}\right\}\leq\dfrac{8}{7}\mathbb{P}\{\mathcal{A}\cap\mathcal{B}\}
≤87ℙ{1N(∑iki′(f𝒟,g𝒟)+∑jpj′(f𝒟,g𝒟)−∑iki(f𝒟,g𝒟)−∑jpj(f𝒟,g𝒟))≥ϵ2(α+β+𝔼[Af𝒟,g𝒟∣𝒟])}\displaystyle\leq\dfrac{8}{7}\mathbb{P}\Biggl\{\dfrac{1}{N}\left(\sum\limits_{i}k_{i}^{\prime}(f_{\mathscr{D}},g_{\mathscr{D}})+\sum\limits_{j}p_{j}^{\prime}(f_{\mathscr{D}},g_{\mathscr{D}})-\sum\limits_{i}k_{i}(f_{\mathscr{D}},g_{\mathscr{D}})-\sum\limits_{j}p_{j}(f_{\mathscr{D}},g_{\mathscr{D}})\right)\geq\dfrac{\epsilon}{2}\left(\alpha+\beta+\mathbb{E}\Bigl[A_{f_{\mathscr{D}},g_{\mathscr{D}}}\mid\mathscr{D}\Bigr]\right)\Biggr\}
≤87​ℙ​{∃(f,g)∈ℱ×𝒢:1N​(∑i(ki′​(f,g)−ki​(f,g))+∑j(pj′​(f,g)−pj​(f,g)))≥ϵ2​(α+β+𝔼⁡[Af,g])}.\displaystyle\leq\dfrac{8}{7}\mathbb{P}\Biggl\{\exists(f,g)\in\mathcal{F}\times\mathcal{G}:\dfrac{1}{N}\left(\sum\limits_{i}\bigl(k_{i}^{\prime}(f,g)-k_{i}(f,g)\bigr)+\sum\limits_{j}\bigl(p_{j}^{\prime}(f,g)-p_{j}(f,g)\bigr)\right)\geq\dfrac{\epsilon}{2}\left(\alpha+\beta+\mathbb{E}\Bigl[A_{f,g}\Bigr]\right)\Biggr\}.

Therefore (13) holds.

Step 2. Population to empirical

Next, we show that

ℙ⁡{∃(f,g)∈ℱ×𝒢:1N​(∑i(ki′−ki)+∑j(pj′−pj))≥ϵ2​(α+β+𝔼⁡[Af,g])}\displaystyle\mathbb{P}\left\{\exists(f,g)\in\mathcal{F}\times\mathcal{G}:\dfrac{1}{N}\left(\sum\limits_{i}(k_{i}^{\prime}-k_{i})+\sum\limits_{j}(p_{j}^{\prime}-p_{j})\right)\geq\dfrac{\epsilon}{2}\left(\alpha+\beta+\mathbb{E}\Bigl[A_{f,g}\Bigr]\right)\right\}
≤ℙ{∃(f,g)∈ℱ×𝒢:1N(∑i(ki′−ki)+∑j(pj′−pj))≥ϵ2(α+β)\displaystyle\leq\mathbb{P}\Bigg\{\exists(f,g)\in\mathcal{F}\times\mathcal{G}:\dfrac{1}{N}\left(\sum\limits_{i}(k_{i}^{\prime}-k_{i})+\sum\limits_{j}(p_{j}^{\prime}-p_{j})\right)\geq\dfrac{\epsilon}{2}\left(\alpha+\beta\right)
+ϵ64​(λ+1)​B21−ϵ1+ϵ(1N(∑i(ki2+ki′2)+∑j(pj2+pj′2))−2​ϵ1−ϵ(α+β))}\displaystyle\qquad\qquad+\dfrac{\epsilon}{64(\lambda+1)B^{2}}\dfrac{1-\epsilon}{1+\epsilon}\left(\dfrac{1}{N}\left(\sum\limits_{i}(k_{i}^{2}+k_{i}^{\prime 2})+\sum\limits_{j}(p_{j}^{2}+p_{j}^{\prime 2})\right)-\dfrac{2\epsilon}{1-\epsilon}(\alpha+\beta)\right)\Bigg\}
+8​𝔼​[𝒩1​(α+β10​a,𝒢k,zn)+𝒩1​(α+β10​b,𝒢p,zm)]​exp⁡(−ϵ2​(α+β)​N480​B4​(λ+1)2).\displaystyle+8\mathbb{E}\left[\mathcal{N}_{1}\left(\dfrac{\alpha+\beta}{10a},\mathcal{G}_{k},z^{n}\right)+\mathcal{N}_{1}\left(\dfrac{\alpha+\beta}{10b},\mathcal{G}_{p},z^{m}\right)\right]\exp\left(-\dfrac{\epsilon^{2}(\alpha+\beta)N}{480B^{4}(\lambda+1)^{2}}\right). (16)

To prove (16), we first present the following lemma.

Lemma C.3.

Let 𝒢k={k⁡(f,g):(f,g)∈ℱ×𝒢},𝒢p={p⁡(f,g):(f,g)∈ℱ×𝒢}\mathcal{G}_{k}=\{k(f,g):(f,g)\in\mathcal{F}\times\mathcal{G}\},\ \mathcal{G}_{p}=\{p(f,g):(f,g)\in\mathcal{F}\times\mathcal{G}\}. (zn,yn),zm(z^{n},y^{n}),z^{m} are the samples used to generate ki,pjk_{i},p_{j} respectively. Then

ℙ⁡{∃(f,g)∈ℱ×𝒢:1N​(∑iki2+∑jpj2)−𝔼⁡[a​k2+b​p2]α+β+1N​(∑iki2+∑jpj2)+𝔼⁡[a​k2+b​p2]≥ϵ}\displaystyle\mathbb{P}\left\{\exists(f,g)\in\mathcal{F}\times\mathcal{G}:\dfrac{\dfrac{1}{N}\left(\sum\limits_{i}k_{i}^{2}+\sum\limits_{j}p_{j}^{2}\right)-\mathbb{E}[ak^{2}+bp^{2}]}{\alpha+\beta+\dfrac{1}{N}\left(\sum\limits_{i}k_{i}^{2}+\sum\limits_{j}p_{j}^{2}\right)+\mathbb{E}[ak^{2}+bp^{2}]}\geq\epsilon\right\}
≤4​𝔼​[𝒩1​(α+β10​a,𝒢k,zn)+𝒩1​(α+β10​b,𝒢p,zm)]​exp⁡(−ϵ2​(α+β)​N480​B4​(λ+1)2).\displaystyle\leq 4\mathbb{E}\left[\mathcal{N}_{1}\left(\dfrac{\alpha+\beta}{10a},\mathcal{G}_{k},z^{n}\right)+\mathcal{N}_{1}\left(\dfrac{\alpha+\beta}{10b},\mathcal{G}_{p},z^{m}\right)\right]\exp\left(-\dfrac{\epsilon^{2}(\alpha+\beta)N}{480B^{4}(\lambda+1)^{2}}\right).
Proof.

The desired bound follows.

ℙ⁡{∃(f,g)∈ℱ×𝒢:1N​(∑iki2+∑jpj2)−𝔼⁡[a​k2+b​p2]α+β+1N​(∑iki2+∑jpj2)+𝔼⁡[a​k2+b​p2]≥ϵ}\displaystyle\mathbb{P}\left\{\exists(f,g)\in\mathcal{F}\times\mathcal{G}:\frac{\dfrac{1}{N}\left(\sum\limits_{i}k_{i}^{2}+\sum\limits_{j}p_{j}^{2}\right)-\mathbb{E}[ak^{2}+bp^{2}]}{\alpha+\beta+\dfrac{1}{N}\left(\sum\limits_{i}k_{i}^{2}+\sum\limits_{j}p_{j}^{2}\right)+\mathbb{E}[ak^{2}+bp^{2}]}\geq\epsilon\right\}
=ℙ{sup(f,g)∈ℱ×𝒢1N​(∑iki2+∑jpj2)−𝔼⁡[a​k2+b​p2]α+β+1N​(∑iki2+∑jpj2)+𝔼⁡[a​k2+b​p2]≥ϵ}\displaystyle=\mathbb{P}\left\{\sup_{(f,g)\in\mathcal{F}\times\mathcal{G}}\dfrac{\dfrac{1}{N}\left(\sum\limits_{i}k_{i}^{2}+\sum\limits_{j}p_{j}^{2}\right)-\mathbb{E}[ak^{2}+bp^{2}]}{\alpha+\beta+\dfrac{1}{N}\left(\sum\limits_{i}k_{i}^{2}+\sum\limits_{j}p_{j}^{2}\right)+\mathbb{E}[ak^{2}+bp^{2}]}\geq\epsilon\right\}
=ℙ{sup(f,g)∈ℱ×𝒢a⁡(1n​∑iki2−𝔼⁡[k2])+b⁡(1m​∑jpj2−𝔼⁡[p2])α+β+a⁡(1n​∑iki2+𝔼⁡[k2])+b⁡(1m​∑jpj2+𝔼⁡[p2])≥ϵ}\displaystyle=\mathbb{P}\left\{\sup_{(f,g)\in\mathcal{F}\times\mathcal{G}}\dfrac{a\left(\dfrac{1}{n}\sum\limits_{i}k_{i}^{2}-\mathbb{E}[k^{2}]\right)+b\left(\dfrac{1}{m}\sum\limits_{j}p_{j}^{2}-\mathbb{E}[p^{2}]\right)}{\alpha+\beta+a\left(\dfrac{1}{n}\sum\limits_{i}k_{i}^{2}+\mathbb{E}[k^{2}]\right)+b\left(\dfrac{1}{m}\sum\limits_{j}p_{j}^{2}+\mathbb{E}[p^{2}]\right)}\geq\epsilon\right\}
≤ℙ{sup(f,g)∈ℱ×𝒢a⁡(1n​∑iki2−𝔼⁡[k2])α+β2+a⁡(1n​∑iki2+𝔼⁡[k2])≥ϵ}+ℙ{sup(f,g)∈ℱ×𝒢b⁡(1m​∑jpj2−𝔼⁡[p2])α+β2+b⁡(1m​∑jpj2+𝔼⁡[p2])≥ϵ}\displaystyle\leq\mathbb{P}\left\{\sup_{(f,g)\in\mathcal{F}\times\mathcal{G}}\dfrac{a\left(\dfrac{1}{n}\sum\limits_{i}k_{i}^{2}-\mathbb{E}[k^{2}]\right)}{\dfrac{\alpha+\beta}{2}+a\left(\dfrac{1}{n}\sum\limits_{i}k_{i}^{2}+\mathbb{E}[k^{2}]\right)}\geq\epsilon\right\}+\mathbb{P}\left\{\sup_{(f,g)\in\mathcal{F}\times\mathcal{G}}\dfrac{b\left(\dfrac{1}{m}\sum\limits_{j}p_{j}^{2}-\mathbb{E}[p^{2}]\right)}{\dfrac{\alpha+\beta}{2}+b\left(\dfrac{1}{m}\sum\limits_{j}p_{j}^{2}+\mathbb{E}[p^{2}]\right)}\geq\epsilon\right\}
≤4​𝔼​[𝒩1​(α+β10​a,𝒢k,zn)+𝒩1​(α+β10​b,𝒢p,zm)]​exp⁡(−ϵ2​(α+β)​N480​B4​(λ+1)2),\displaystyle\leq 4\mathbb{E}\left[\mathcal{N}_{1}\left(\dfrac{\alpha+\beta}{10a},\mathcal{G}_{k},z^{n}\right)+\mathcal{N}_{1}\left(\dfrac{\alpha+\beta}{10b},\mathcal{G}_{p},z^{m}\right)\right]\exp\left(-\dfrac{\epsilon^{2}(\alpha+\beta)N}{480B^{4}(\lambda+1)^{2}}\right),

where the last inequality uses Györfi et al. (2002, Theorem 11.6). ∎

Next, define the events

𝒮1\displaystyle\mathcal{S}_{1} ≔{∃(f,g)∈ℱ×𝒢:1N​(∑i(ki′−ki)+∑j(pj′−pj))≥ϵ2​(α+β+𝔼⁡[Af,g])},\displaystyle\coloneq\Biggl\{\exists(f,g)\in\mathcal{F}\times\mathcal{G}:\frac{1}{N}\Bigl(\sum_{i}(k_{i}^{\prime}-k_{i})+\sum_{j}(p_{j}^{\prime}-p_{j})\Bigr)\geq\frac{\epsilon}{2}\Bigl(\alpha+\beta+\mathbb{E}[A_{f,g}]\Bigr)\Biggr\},
𝒮2\displaystyle\mathcal{S}_{2} ≔{∀(f,g)∈ℱ×𝒢:1N​(∑iki2+∑jpj2)−𝔼⁡[a​k2+b​p2]≤ϵ⁡(α+β+1N​(∑iki2+∑jpj2)+𝔼⁡[a​k2+b​p2])},\displaystyle\coloneq\Biggl\{\forall(f,g)\in\mathcal{F}\times\mathcal{G}:\frac{1}{N}\Bigl(\sum_{i}k_{i}^{2}+\sum_{j}p_{j}^{2}\Bigr)-\mathbb{E}[ak^{2}+bp^{2}]\leq\epsilon\Bigl(\alpha+\beta+\frac{1}{N}\Bigl(\sum_{i}k_{i}^{2}+\sum_{j}p_{j}^{2}\Bigr)+\mathbb{E}[ak^{2}+bp^{2}]\Bigr)\Biggr\},
𝒮3\displaystyle\mathcal{S}_{3} ≔{∀(f,g)∈ℱ×𝒢:1N​(∑i(ki′)2+∑j(pj′)2)−𝔼⁡[a​k2+b​p2]≤ϵ⁡(α+β+1N​(∑i(ki′)2+∑j(pj′)2)+𝔼⁡[a​k2+b​p2])}.\displaystyle\coloneq\Biggl\{\forall(f,g)\in\mathcal{F}\times\mathcal{G}:\frac{1}{N}\Bigl(\sum_{i}(k_{i}^{\prime})^{2}+\sum_{j}(p_{j}^{\prime})^{2}\Bigr)-\mathbb{E}[ak^{2}+bp^{2}]\leq\epsilon\Bigl(\alpha+\beta+\frac{1}{N}\Bigl(\sum_{i}(k_{i}^{\prime})^{2}+\sum_{j}(p_{j}^{\prime})^{2}\Bigr)+\mathbb{E}[ak^{2}+bp^{2}]\Bigr)\Biggr\}.

We have the set inclusion 𝒮1⊂(𝒮1∩𝒮2∩𝒮3)∪𝒮2c∪𝒮3c\mathcal{S}_{1}\subset(\mathcal{S}_{1}\cap\mathcal{S}_{2}\cap\mathcal{S}_{3})\ \cup\ \mathcal{S}_{2}^{c}\ \cup\ \mathcal{S}_{3}^{c}, hence

ℙ⁡(𝒮1)\displaystyle\mathbb{P}(\mathcal{S}_{1}) ≤ℙ⁡(𝒮1∩𝒮2∩𝒮3)+ℙ⁡(𝒮2c)+ℙ⁡(𝒮3c)\displaystyle\leq\mathbb{P}(\mathcal{S}_{1}\cap\mathcal{S}_{2}\cap\mathcal{S}_{3})+\mathbb{P}(\mathcal{S}_{2}^{c})+\mathbb{P}(\mathcal{S}_{3}^{c})
≤ℙ⁡(𝒮1∩𝒮2∩𝒮3)+2​ℙ​(𝒮2c)\displaystyle\leq\mathbb{P}(\mathcal{S}_{1}\cap\mathcal{S}_{2}\cap\mathcal{S}_{3})+2\,\mathbb{P}(\mathcal{S}_{2}^{c})
≤ℙ{∃(f,g)∈ℱ×𝒢:1N(∑i(ki′−ki)+∑j(pj′−pj))≥ϵ2(α+β)\displaystyle\leq\mathbb{P}\Bigg\{\exists(f,g)\in\mathcal{F}\times\mathcal{G}:\dfrac{1}{N}\left(\sum\limits_{i}(k_{i}^{\prime}-k_{i})+\sum\limits_{j}(p_{j}^{\prime}-p_{j})\right)\geq\dfrac{\epsilon}{2}\left(\alpha+\beta\right)
+ϵ64​(λ+1)​B21−ϵ1+ϵ(1N(∑i(ki2+ki′2)+∑j(pj2+pj′2))−2​ϵ1−ϵ(α+β))}\displaystyle\qquad+\dfrac{\epsilon}{64(\lambda+1)B^{2}}\dfrac{1-\epsilon}{1+\epsilon}\left(\dfrac{1}{N}\left(\sum\limits_{i}(k_{i}^{2}+k_{i}^{\prime 2})+\sum\limits_{j}(p_{j}^{2}+p_{j}^{\prime 2})\right)-\dfrac{2\epsilon}{1-\epsilon}(\alpha+\beta)\right)\Bigg\}
+8​𝔼​[𝒩1​(α+β10​a,𝒢k,zn)+𝒩1​(α+β10​b,𝒢p,zm)]​exp⁡(−ϵ2​(α+β)​N480​B4​(λ+1)2),\displaystyle+8\mathbb{E}\left[\mathcal{N}_{1}\left(\dfrac{\alpha+\beta}{10a},\mathcal{G}_{k},z^{n}\right)+\mathcal{N}_{1}\left(\dfrac{\alpha+\beta}{10b},\mathcal{G}_{p},z^{m}\right)\right]\exp\left(-\dfrac{\epsilon^{2}(\alpha+\beta)N}{480B^{4}(\lambda+1)^{2}}\right),

where the last inequality uses Lemma C.3 and the fact that 𝒮2\mathcal{S}_{2} implies

𝔼⁡[Af,g]≥(∗)116​(λ+1)​B2​𝔼​[a​k2+b​p2]≥116​(λ+1)​B2​1−ϵ1+ϵ​(1N​(∑iki2+∑jpj2)−ϵ1−ϵ​(α+β))\mathbb{E}\left[A_{f,g}\right]\stackrel{{\scriptstyle(*)}}{{\geq}}\frac{1}{16(\lambda+1)B^{2}}\mathbb{E}[ak^{2}+bp^{2}]\geq\frac{1}{16(\lambda+1)B^{2}}\dfrac{1-\epsilon}{1+\epsilon}\left(\dfrac{1}{N}\left(\sum\limits_{i}k_{i}^{2}+\sum\limits_{j}p_{j}^{2}\right)-\dfrac{\epsilon}{1-\epsilon}(\alpha+\beta)\right)

Similarly for 𝒟′\mathscr{D}^{\prime}, 𝒮3\mathcal{S}_{3} implies

𝔼⁡[Af,g]≥(∗)116​(λ+1)​B2​𝔼​[a​k2+b​p2]≥116​(λ+1)​B2​1−ϵ1+ϵ​(1N​(∑iki′2+∑jpj′2)−ϵ1−ϵ​(α+β)),\mathbb{E}\left[A_{f,g}\right]\stackrel{{\scriptstyle(*)}}{{\geq}}\frac{1}{16(\lambda+1)B^{2}}\mathbb{E}[ak^{2}+bp^{2}]\geq\frac{1}{16(\lambda+1)B^{2}}\dfrac{1-\epsilon}{1+\epsilon}\left(\dfrac{1}{N}\left(\sum\limits_{i}k_{i}^{\prime 2}+\sum\limits_{j}p_{j}^{\prime 2}\right)-\dfrac{\epsilon}{1-\epsilon}(\alpha+\beta)\right),

where (∗)(*) follows by (15). Therefore (16) holds.

Step 3. Rademacher variables. We introduce independent Rademacher variables {Ui}i=1n\{U_{i}\}_{i=1}^{n} and {Uj′}j=n+1N\{U^{\prime}_{j}\}_{j=n+1}^{N}, i.e., i.i.d. random variables satisfying ℙ⁡(Ui=1)=ℙ⁡(Ui=−1)=ℙ⁡(Uj′=1)=ℙ⁡(Uj′=−1)=12\mathbb{P}(U_{i}=1)=\mathbb{P}(U_{i}=-1)=\mathbb{P}(U^{\prime}_{j}=1)=\mathbb{P}(U^{\prime}_{j}=-1)=\tfrac{1}{2}. Then

ℙ{∃(f,g)∈ℱ×𝒢:1N(∑i(ki′−ki)+∑j(pj′−pj))≥ϵ2(α+β)\displaystyle\mathbb{P}\Bigg\{\exists(f,g)\in\mathcal{F}\times\mathcal{G}:\dfrac{1}{N}\left(\sum\limits_{i}(k_{i}^{\prime}-k_{i})+\sum\limits_{j}(p_{j}^{\prime}-p_{j})\right)\geq\dfrac{\epsilon}{2}\left(\alpha+\beta\right)
+ϵ64​(λ+1)​B21−ϵ1+ϵ(1N(∑i(ki2+ki′2)+∑j(pj2+pj′2))−2​ϵ1−ϵ(α+β))}\displaystyle\qquad+\dfrac{\epsilon}{64(\lambda+1)B^{2}}\dfrac{1-\epsilon}{1+\epsilon}\left(\dfrac{1}{N}\left(\sum\limits_{i}(k_{i}^{2}+k_{i}^{\prime 2})+\sum\limits_{j}(p_{j}^{2}+p_{j}^{\prime 2})\right)-\dfrac{2\epsilon}{1-\epsilon}(\alpha+\beta)\right)\Bigg\}
≤2ℙ{∃(f,g)∈ℱ×𝒢:1N|∑iUiki+∑jUjpj|≥ϵ4(α+β)\displaystyle\leq 2\mathbb{P}\Bigg\{\exists(f,g)\in\mathcal{F}\times\mathcal{G}:\dfrac{1}{N}\left|\sum\limits_{i}U_{i}k_{i}+\sum\limits_{j}U_{j}p_{j}\right|\geq\dfrac{\epsilon}{4}\left(\alpha+\beta\right)
+ϵ64​(λ+1)​B21−ϵ1+ϵ(1N(∑iki2+∑jpj2)−ϵ1−ϵ(α+β))},\displaystyle\qquad+\dfrac{\epsilon}{64(\lambda+1)B^{2}}\dfrac{1-\epsilon}{1+\epsilon}\left(\dfrac{1}{N}\left(\sum\limits_{i}k_{i}^{2}+\sum\limits_{j}p_{j}^{2}\right)-\dfrac{\epsilon}{1-\epsilon}(\alpha+\beta)\right)\Bigg\}, (17)

which follows by symmetrization and a union bound.

ℙ{∃(f,g)∈ℱ×𝒢:1N(∑i(ki′−ki)+∑j(pj′−pj))≥ϵ2(α+β)\displaystyle\mathbb{P}\Bigg\{\exists(f,g)\in\mathcal{F}\times\mathcal{G}:\dfrac{1}{N}\left(\sum\limits_{i}(k_{i}^{\prime}-k_{i})+\sum\limits_{j}(p_{j}^{\prime}-p_{j})\right)\geq\dfrac{\epsilon}{2}\left(\alpha+\beta\right)
+ϵ64​(λ+1)​B21−ϵ1+ϵ(1N(∑i(ki2+ki′2)+∑j(pj2+pj′2))−2​ϵ1−ϵ(α+β))}\displaystyle\qquad+\dfrac{\epsilon}{64(\lambda+1)B^{2}}\dfrac{1-\epsilon}{1+\epsilon}\left(\dfrac{1}{N}\left(\sum\limits_{i}(k_{i}^{2}+k_{i}^{\prime 2})+\sum\limits_{j}(p_{j}^{2}+p_{j}^{\prime 2})\right)-\dfrac{2\epsilon}{1-\epsilon}(\alpha+\beta)\right)\Bigg\}
=ℙ{∃(f,g)∈ℱ×𝒢:1N(∑iUi′ki′−Uiki+∑jUj′pj′−Ujpj)≥ϵ2(α+β)\displaystyle=\mathbb{P}\Bigg\{\exists(f,g)\in\mathcal{F}\times\mathcal{G}:\dfrac{1}{N}\left(\sum\limits_{i}U_{i}^{\prime}k_{i}^{\prime}-U_{i}k_{i}+\sum\limits_{j}U_{j}^{\prime}p_{j}^{\prime}-U_{j}p_{j}\right)\geq\dfrac{\epsilon}{2}\left(\alpha+\beta\right)
+ϵ64​(λ+1)​B21−ϵ1+ϵ(1N(∑i(ki2+ki′2)+∑j(pj2+pj′2))−2​ϵ1−ϵ(α+β))}\displaystyle\qquad+\dfrac{\epsilon}{64(\lambda+1)B^{2}}\dfrac{1-\epsilon}{1+\epsilon}\left(\dfrac{1}{N}\left(\sum\limits_{i}(k_{i}^{2}+k_{i}^{\prime 2})+\sum\limits_{j}(p_{j}^{2}+p_{j}^{\prime 2})\right)-\dfrac{2\epsilon}{1-\epsilon}(\alpha+\beta)\right)\Bigg\}
≤ℙ{∃(f,g)∈ℱ×𝒢:1N|∑iUiki+∑jUjpj|≥ϵ4(α+β)\displaystyle\leq\mathbb{P}\Bigg\{\exists(f,g)\in\mathcal{F}\times\mathcal{G}:\dfrac{1}{N}\left|\sum\limits_{i}U_{i}k_{i}+\sum\limits_{j}U_{j}p_{j}\right|\geq\dfrac{\epsilon}{4}\left(\alpha+\beta\right)
+ϵ64​(λ+1)​B21−ϵ1+ϵ(1N(∑iki2+∑jpj2)−ϵ1−ϵ(α+β))}\displaystyle\qquad+\dfrac{\epsilon}{64(\lambda+1)B^{2}}\dfrac{1-\epsilon}{1+\epsilon}\left(\dfrac{1}{N}\left(\sum\limits_{i}k_{i}^{2}+\sum\limits_{j}p_{j}^{2}\right)-\dfrac{\epsilon}{1-\epsilon}(\alpha+\beta)\right)\Bigg\}
+ℙ{∃(f,g)∈ℱ×𝒢:1N|∑iUi′ki′+∑jUj′pj′|≥ϵ4(α+β)\displaystyle+\mathbb{P}\Bigg\{\exists(f,g)\in\mathcal{F}\times\mathcal{G}:\dfrac{1}{N}\left|\sum\limits_{i}U_{i}^{\prime}k^{\prime}_{i}+\sum\limits_{j}U_{j}^{\prime}p_{j}^{\prime}\right|\geq\dfrac{\epsilon}{4}\left(\alpha+\beta\right)
+ϵ64​(λ+1)​B21−ϵ1+ϵ(1N(∑iki′2+∑jpj′2)−ϵ1−ϵ(α+β))}\displaystyle\qquad+\dfrac{\epsilon}{64(\lambda+1)B^{2}}\dfrac{1-\epsilon}{1+\epsilon}\left(\dfrac{1}{N}\left(\sum\limits_{i}k_{i}^{\prime 2}+\sum\limits_{j}p_{j}^{\prime 2}\right)-\dfrac{\epsilon}{1-\epsilon}(\alpha+\beta)\right)\Bigg\}
=2ℙ{∃(f,g)∈ℱ×𝒢:1N|∑iUiki+∑jUjpj|≥ϵ4(α+β)\displaystyle=2\mathbb{P}\Bigg\{\exists(f,g)\in\mathcal{F}\times\mathcal{G}:\dfrac{1}{N}\left|\sum\limits_{i}U_{i}k_{i}+\sum\limits_{j}U_{j}p_{j}\right|\geq\dfrac{\epsilon}{4}\left(\alpha+\beta\right)
+ϵ64​(λ+1)​B21−ϵ1+ϵ(1N(∑iki2+∑jpj2)−ϵ1−ϵ(α+β))}.\displaystyle\qquad+\dfrac{\epsilon}{64(\lambda+1)B^{2}}\dfrac{1-\epsilon}{1+\epsilon}\left(\dfrac{1}{N}\left(\sum\limits_{i}k_{i}^{2}+\sum\limits_{j}p_{j}^{2}\right)-\dfrac{\epsilon}{1-\epsilon}(\alpha+\beta)\right)\Bigg\}.

Therefore (17) holds.

Step 4. Covering numbers. Define Γδ\Gamma_{\delta} as a smallest subset of ℱ×𝒢\mathcal{F}\times\mathcal{G} such that, for every (f,g)∈ℱ×𝒢(f,g)\in\mathcal{F}\times\mathcal{G}, there exists (f~,g~)∈Γδ(\tilde{f},\tilde{g})\in\Gamma_{\delta} satisfying
